page.overview:
Who is Cassiopia?

Cassiopia makes an appearance in the Day of the Triforce story from Issue #5 of . and their son Rus. She goes to the North Palace to inform Princess Zelda that Lynels have attacked her town and asks for her aid.

When she and Zelda return to defeat the monsters with the help of the rest of the people of Saria, the River Man informs Cassiopia that their son, Rus, has been gravely wounded by a Rope.

Desperate, Cassiopia confesses that Rus is beyond her healing powers and that he will not last beyond sundown, but just then Zelda tells her that she will go to the Magic Spring and bring a fairy to cure the boy.

Although Cassiopia wants her to go, her husband insists that Zelda go and destroy Ganon instead, for who knows how many other children will die if the Prince of Darkness is not stopped once and for all. In the end, Princess Zelda brings back Miff to heal Rus, greatly overjoying Cassiopia as she sees her son cured.
